detailColumnsJson.title: Detail Columns Json
detailColumnsJson.description: JSON array of column apiName values. Do not include grouping columns.

filtersJson.title: Filters Json
filtersJson.description: JSON array of objects with column, operator, and value

groupingsDownJson.title: Groupings Down Json
groupingsDownJson.description: JSON array of column apiName values to group by. Required for SUMMARY.

reportName.title: Report Name
reportName.description: Short report name derived from the request

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Report scope. Use organization unless the user asks for only their own records.

standardDateColumn.title: Standard Date Column
standardDateColumn.description: defaultDateColumn from columnsJson when the user names a date range

standardDateDuration.title: Standard Date Duration
standardDateDuration.description: Duration such as THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER, THIS_QUARTER, THIS_MONTH, or THIS_FISCAL_YEAR

standardFiltersJson.title: Standard Filters Json
standardFiltersJson.description: JSON array of name and value from standardFilters, such as open and open
